role: Introduce Tally as an intake point for automated workflows
subject: A form that starts the workflow
preview_text: Tally sends new submissions as structured JSON to your endpoint in real time.
headline: Start the workflow with a submission
body:
Tally is available as an online form builder built for more than collecting responses. Each submission can become the live starting signal for the systems that need it.

Configure a webhook, and Tally can send each new response as structured JSON to any HTTP endpoint in real time. That could be your own backend or a workflow routed through Make, Zapier or n8n.

For an extra verification step, Tally can sign webhook requests with a SHA256 signature. Your receiving system can check that the payload came from Tally before processing it.

Start by building a free form. Then connect its webhook and inspect a fresh submission and signature to see how Tally could fit your workflow.
